reader.requirement: At --std 85 every CLOSE of a relative file (plain or WITH LOCK, successful or not) must update the file's I-O status with a value from the relative I-O status list (§1985:VIII.1.3.4): 00 on success, 42 for a file not in the open mode, 30 for a permanent error, and the value must be visible in the FILE STATUS item and to an applicable USE procedure.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: which object a successful WITH LOCK locks (physical file at 85); the status it sets is the plain CLOSE's on both arms
WITH LOCK accepted at 85, refused at 2023

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/DialectBehavior in FileConnector.Close, FileRegistry CloseCell/CloseByFormat and SequentialIoEmitter.EmitClose; the status-setting path consults no edition. The 07 status (CloseUnit/PhrasesIgnored cells) is unreachable for a relative file because BindClose refuses REEL/UNIT/NO REWIND on a non-sequential file (COBOL1693), matching the 1985 relative status list, which has no 07.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the statuses a relative CLOSE sets are the same at every edition; WITH LOCK itself is gone at 2023.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb141_close_forms and pb140_close_status are sequential; the relative organization, the USE procedure seeing the status, CLOSE WITH LOCK's status and the optional-file CLOSE are exercised by this slice's probes; 30 (a failing medium) is not probed

probes.printed: CLOSE1=00, CLOSE2=42, AFTER-FAIL=42, MULTI=00 00, MULTI2=00 42, LOCK=00, LOCKED-CLOSE=42, USE-RC 42 then RC-NOTOPEN=42, RC-LOCK=00, RC-LOCK2=42
probes.expected: the I-O status is updated by every CLOSE: 00 success, 42 not open (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 (5) b), visible in FILE STATUS and to USE

probes.printed: CLOSE=00, CLOSE2=00, CLOSELOCK=00, Q-CLOSE=00, Q-CLOSE2=42, Q-CLOSEIO=00
probes.expected: status updated to 00 for a successful CLOSE of an absent optional file, 42 once closed

probes.printed: error COBOL1693 (NO REWIND/REEL/UNIT refused on a relative file), so no 07 is reachable
probes.expected: the 1985 relative status list has no 07; the phrases are not in the relative CLOSE format

reader.notes: FileConnector.Close sets and returns the status on every path (42 guard, mapped CloseCore with 30 for an OS failure); the emitter stores it into the FILE STATUS item and calls the USE hook per file-name. The permanent-error 30 path was read, not probed (it needs a failing medium).

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-027/clsglob.cob (clsglob-001): FILE STATUS item SA inside a GLOBAL group (<SA>) preset to 99 before each CALL; a nested program's CLOSE RA WITH LOCK of the GLOBAL file updates it to <00>, then <42> the second time, visible in both programs. cls2.cob: every CLOSE (00, 42, inside USE) updates the status and the USE procedure sees 42. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.2.4 GR3 the text is in GR3. Status 30 is not probeable without a failing medium (read only, as the reader said).
